description.value: Taos Cafe (陶李食堂 in Cantonese) is a Chinese fast-food eatery situated in a commercial unit in Richmond, BC — a city renowned for the depth and quality of its Chinese dining scene. The no-drive-through setup indicates walk-in counter service, typical of the quick-service Chinese restaurants for which Richmond is well known. For a touring cyclist passing through, it represents a convenient and culturally distinct meal stop in the heart of one of Canada's most food-rich suburbs.
